Name: Beth-diblathaim
Description: A town of Moab named in Jeremiah's judgment upon Moab, among Dibon, Nebo, Kiriathaim and the cities of the plain and of the high places.
BiblicalSignificance: Beth-diblathaim is one of Moab's judged towns: a name in a long oracle showing that no Moabite city stood outside the LORD's reckoning.
